lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular 2D grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of spots, creating a checkerboard pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher pixel intensity on the upper edge and lower intensity/shadow on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 12 discrete high-luminance blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, clustered mainly in the basal and medial regions.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense field of minute, lower-contrast spots is visible on the cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit, distinct from the larger flank patterning.
